heading: Limitation on authority
lead: Nothing in this chapter authorizes the Foundation to perform any function the exclusive authority for which is provided to the National Park Foundation by subchapter II of chapter 1011 of title 54.

notes.text: Amendments2020—Pub. L. 116–188 inserted “exclusive” before “authority”. 2014—Pub. L. 113–287 substituted “subchapter II of chapter 1011 of title 54” for “Public Law 90–209 (16 U.S.C. 19e et seq.)”.
